plain: Silly lightness or joking where seriousness is called for

webster.text: Lightness; the want of weight in a body, compared with another that is heavier.

more.text: Want of due consideration; vanity; freak.
Gayety of mind; want of seriousness; disposition to trifle.

example.quote: Attempts of this kind would not often be made with levity or rashness, because they could seldom be made without danger to the authors, unless in cases of a tyrannical exercise of the federal authority.
